author: zeNinjaGuy
body:
Name:
CrazyBlader

Reason:
First I got Temp-Banned for not being a good sport (saying 'ez' every time i die)
That was only suppose to last for 12 hours

However I then later got Perm-Banned for 'Ban Evasion'. All i did was ask my friend CrazyHarv to deliver some messages to some people.
I didn't go on his account then played - because we are separate people - I know, we have friends....
My name might be similar to CrazyHarv but my original name was MajesticBlader, i changed it to CrazyBlader because I met him and i liked the ring to it. He has been playing minecraft for much longer than me. If some people doesn't realized, similar name != same person (i know right... mind blowing - also if you do some sort of programming you should know what != means) 
CrazyHarv also got banned, because Oscar is not Amused thought that that was my alt.

If you want evidence - ask CrazyHarv. I don't have his permission to distribute his stuff freely

At the very least unban CrazyHarv because he likes this server more than me... not to say I don't <3

Thanks
